select p.profile_id profileId, p.user_id userId, p.real_name realName, p.organization, p.professional_title professionalTitle, p.research_field researchField, p.industry_field industryField, p.service_region serviceRegion, p.review_status reviewStatus, p.service_status serviceStatus, coalesce(p.credit_score, 100) creditScore, p.graph_version graphVersion, p.approved_time approvedTime, p.version profileVersion, coalesce(s.schedule_count, 0) scheduleCount, r.release_id latestReleaseId, r.version_no latestReleaseNo, r.graph_version latestGraphVersion, r.create_time latestReleaseTime from expert_profile p left join ( select user_id, count(*) schedule_count from expert_schedule where weekly_capacity > 0 group by user_id ) s on s.user_id = p.user_id left join expert_release_version r on r.release_id = ( select max(r2.release_id) from expert_release_version r2 where r2.user_id = p.user_id ) where p.review_status = 'APPROVED' and p.del_flag = '0' and p.service_status <> 'EXITED'
and ( p.real_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.organization like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.research_field like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.industry_field like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.service_region like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
and p.real_name like concat('%', #{realName}, '%')
and p.organization like concat('%', #{organization}, '%')
and p.service_status = #{serviceStatus}
order by p.approved_time desc, p.user_id desc

select material_id materialId, file_name fileName, file_type fileType, version_no versionNo, review_status reviewStatus, review_comment reviewComment, valid_from validFrom, valid_until validUntil, update_time updateTime from expert_material where user_id = #{userId} and material_category = 'OTHER' and review_status = 'APPROVED' order by version_no desc, material_id desc limit 1

select context_id contextId, expert_user_id expertUserId, external_task_id externalTaskId, task_type taskType, service_start serviceStart, service_end serviceEnd, service_mode serviceMode, service_region serviceRegion, industry, occupancy_status occupancyStatus, conflict_status conflictStatus, source_system sourceSystem, source_kind sourceKind, source_version sourceVersion, verified_at verifiedAt from expert_business_context_snapshot where expert_user_id = #{userId} and external_task_id is not null and trim(external_task_id) != '' and service_start < #{serviceEnd} and service_end > #{serviceStart} order by service_start, context_id
